Hi Jordan —

Great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap and the specific follow-ups we discussed on the call: 

- You confirmed you want Redwood to process live inference for AcmeFin, but you do NOT want any customer data (including PII) used for model training or product improvement.
- Next steps for us: provide a written opt-out confirmation template and confirm logging/retention behavior so Procurement/Legal can sign.
- Action items for AcmeFin: confirm the opt-out decision (yes/no) and share the preferred signee for the opt-out form.

To make this easy for Procurement, I attached a short opt-out form we can use for signatures. If you confirm, we'll:
1) Toggle the account-level setting to exclude AcmeFin data from model training and improvement.
2) Create an internal compliance ticket and record (Doc ID + link).
3) Confirm active data residency region (we currently have your tenant in us-east-1) and describe logging/retention controls below.

Logging & retention (high level):
- Request/response payloads are retained in active logs for 90 days by default.
- We can disable verbose debug traces and redact PII at the ingestion layer upon request.
- Audit logs (access, configuration changes) are retained for 1 year and can be exported on demand.

Please reply to this thread with the signee's name and we will send a DocuSign link and process the opt-out immediately.
